The Great Rewriting

AI is fundamentally reshaping the three pillars of the human condition.

PAST DIGITAL AFTERLIFE

Memory & Griefbots

AI generates synthetic memories, cloned voices, and posthumous interactive avatars ('Deadbots'), blurring the boundary between living memory and digital resurrection.

Ethical Question: Does perpetual digital presence halt the natural human process of grief?
PRESENT CLINICAL CARE

The Empathy Paradox

In recent randomized studies (including Google AMIE benchmarks), AI conversational agents scored higher in empathy, warmth, and thoroughness than time-constrained doctors.

Clinical Paradigm: AI acts as an 'Empathic Co-pilot', absorbing documentation to restore human doctor connection.

Longevity Escape Velocity

Four Ethical Dilemmas

  • Biological Inequality & Enhanced Castes

    The risk of creating a permanently enhanced 'Homo Deus' class that accumulates compound wealth and vitality over centuries.

  • Religion Escape Velocity

    Biotech displacing theological solace: offering physical resurrection through griefbots and earthly eternal life in place of heaven.

  • Grey Memory & Subjective Identity

    When human brains exceed 120+ years, does narrative personal identity survive, or will memory synthesis rewrite our authentic past?

  • Societal Stagnation & Generational Gridlock

    If leadership, tenured faculty, and wealth never vacate, how do human culture and youth renew themselves?
